description: A sheet-metal part's parameters changed, every bend read back, and the part after it.

title.description: The document's title as SOLIDWORKS shows it.

path.description: The full path, absent while the document has never been saved.

dirty.description: True when the document has unsaved changes.

visible.description: False for a document SOLIDWORKS loaded only because an open assembly uses it: it has no window of its own.

name.description: Its name, for example Sketch3 or Line2.

kind.description: What it is: feature, sketch, sketch_entity, sketch_point, dimension, plane, axis or point.

reference.description: Its persistent reference; absent when SOLIDWORKS gives none. References are opaque: pass one back exactly as it was given, and never build or change one.

created.description: What it made (features, sketches, sketch entities), in the order it made them.

items.description: A value a model-changing operation edited.

name.description: What was edited, for example D1@Sketch1.

property.description: Which of its properties: value, or suppressed.

before.description: Its value before, with its unit, for example 40 mm.

after.description: Its value after, with its unit.

changed.description: What it edited, each with its value before and after.

errors.description: How many features have a rebuild error.

warnings.description: How many features have a rebuild warning.

items.description: A feature with a rebuild error or warning.

code.description: SOLIDWORKS' error code name (swFeatureError_e), for example swFeatureErrorFilletNoEdge.

warning.description: True for a warning, false for an error.

items.description: Each feature with an error or warning.

rebuild.description: The part's rebuild errors and warnings after the change, by feature.

volume_before_mm3.description: Volume of the solid bodies before the change, mm³.

volume_after_mm3.description: Volume of the solid bodies after the change, mm³.

min.description: The corner with the smallest coordinates.

max.description: The corner with the largest coordinates.

box.description: The box around the solid bodies after the change (SOLIDWORKS' quick box), mm; absent when the part has no solid body.

change.description: The evidence: each value changed with its before and after, and the part's rebuild status, bodies and volume before and after.

items.description: A bend of a sheet-metal part, as SOLIDWORKS reads it back.

name.description: Its name, for example EdgeBend1 or BaseBend1.

reference.description: Its persistent reference (a feature reference). References are opaque: pass one back exactly as it was given, and never build or change one.

feature.description: The feature it belongs to, for example Base-Flange1.

angle_deg.description: How far it bends, degrees: 90 for a right angle.

k_factor.description: The K-factor: where the neutral layer sits across the thickness, more than 0 and at most 1 (0.5 is the middle). The bend develops to angle × (inner radius + K × thickness).

allowance_mm.description: The bend allowance itself, mm, more than 0: the length the bend develops to, whatever its angle.

deduction_mm.description: The bend deduction, mm, 0 or more: what the bend takes off the sum of the two flanges' outer lengths to the virtual sharp.

allowance.description: How it develops when flattened; empty when SOLIDWORKS takes it from a bend or gauge table, which is not read.

default_radius.description: True when its radius is the part's default.

default_allowance.description: True when its allowance is the part's default.

width_mm.description: How long it is along its axis, mm; absent when its axis is not along x, y or z.

bends.description: The bends this operation made (for sheetmetal.set_parameters, every bend of the part), as SOLIDWORKS reads them back.

sheet.description: The sheet's thickness and state, and every bend of the part as SOLIDWORKS reads it back now.

length_mm.description: The rectangle's length (its longer side), mm.

bends.description: How many bends the cut list counts.

flat_before.description: The flat pattern's size before the change; absent when the cut list did not give it.

length_mm.description: The rectangle's length (its longer side), mm.

bends.description: How many bends the cut list counts.

flat_after.description: The flat pattern's size after the change; absent when the cut list does not give it.

checks.description: The checks made, each as a sentence with what was expected and measured.
